content: VS Code manifest/contribution documentation (https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/extension-manifest and https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/contribution-points) demonstrates versioned host compatibility plus declarative UI contributions. CEL (https://cel.dev/overview/cel-overview) separates parse/check/evaluate. Tapestry should version API, data, and behavior independently and compile rules into inspectable typed primitives.
